notes.title: Dancing Game Rework & More Exciting Changes!
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for your amazing support for Cinderella VR!
We've been thrilled to see some great reviews and some awesome Let's Play videos- it's been so cool seeing everyone enjoy the game!!

Our update comes with some big changes!  We altered the dancing mini game so it's easier and more fun to play- we think you'll love it!  Players can hold their controllers on the spheres, which make the incoming music notes easier to hit.

We also adjusted audio levels throughout the game for a more enjoyable and immersive virtual experience.

Lastly, we fixed a bug with player height detection- so if certain minigames were too low to play before, they are at the correct height now!

We hope you've been loving the game so far- thanks so much for playing Cinderella VR!
